scripts.build: pnpm --filter @narra/contracts build && pnpm --filter @narra/project-store build && pnpm --filter @narra/render build && pnpm --filter @narra/desktop build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @narra/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @narra/project-store typecheck && pnpm --filter @narra/render typecheck && pnpm --filter @narra/desktop typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.package:win: pnpm build && node scripts/prepare-desktop-package.mjs && pnpm --filter @narra/desktop package:win
